rules.requirement: Reserve a cost iff the mathematical sum of used and cost fits the budget, without machine overflow.
rules.scope: reserve_budget; not candidate scoring, cost computation or JSON serialization
rules.domain: All 64-bit usize values for used, cost and budget; no input assumptions or loops.

rules.requirement: A strict gate accepts iff analysis is complete and there are zero breaking changes; non-strict mode accepts.
rules.scope: contract_gate; not correctness or completeness of the OpenAPI analyzer
rules.domain: All boolean inputs and 64-bit breaking counts; no input assumptions or loops.

rules.requirement: Replacing a valid range preserves the prefix and suffix byte-for-byte and inserts exactly the replacement; invalid ranges are rejected.
rules.scope: replace_range; not marker parsing, template rendering, filesystem writes or symlink races
rules.domain: ASCII strings of 0..4 bytes; start/end 0..5; Kani unwind 6 with unwinding assertions enabled. Unicode is tested separately, not formally claimed.

trust: Kani, its pinned Rust frontend, CBMC and the solver, plus the execution environment
The reviewed harness and rule registry capture the intended properties
Integration tests cover wiring; proofs apply to primitives rather than every caller
SHA-256 binds report inputs but is not a signature or proof of trusted report authorship
